title: Machine Shop - Operations Manager
description:
The shop operations manager is responsible for the management and integration of shop activities in line with ISO:9001 \& ISO:19443 along SQDC approach with to ensure quality products are delivered as required by the business. In addition they are knowledgeable on current manufacturing technologies, evaluate those technologies for the business. Demonstrate appropriate leadership behaviors to guide the team.
   

  

**Your Role** 
 : Machine Shop \- Operations Manager
   

  

**Reporting To** 
 : COE Turbine Shop
   

  

* Drive and coordinate the execution with (SQDC)Zero deviation in Safety and Quality.
* Ensure alignment of different stakeholders to achieve OTD \& shop Utilization.
* Demonstrate appropriate leadership behavior to guide the team and standard work.
* Drive nuclear safety culture awareness in shop floor.
* Perform the daily operations of plants to ensure reliability and consistency on the production line. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline, ensure maximum efficiency and productivity as well as minimization of delays.
* Leads and coaches team members in a positive manner to maximize their potential and their contributions to key performance goals for the company.
* Assists in production scheduling to ensure optimal utilization of equipment and people for best possible results
* Create awareness among team to raise stop work/Quality Concern on small deviations
* Closely work with Process engineer for any improvement on current manufacturing process/new upcoming projects
* Identify training need of the team based on the skill assessment and new project requirement.
* Control, Organize, monitor production operations as per plan, implement corrective action as necessary. Make recovery plan for delays, implement, and ensure targets agreed are achieved
* Ensure correct allocation of resources to make the Lean concepts deployment a success, make problems visible, and allow problem solving to take place.
* Lead and guide the team to develop \& execute objectives for self \& others with alignment to short\-term \& long\-term business goals of the organization.
* Mobilize onsite support and new development whenever needed
* Responsible for EHS \& 5S in the respective area of the shop
* Responsible for execution cost (estimate Vs actual)
* Active participation in FMEA meetings and ensure all relevant risks are identified and mitigated before execution of process
* Identify training need of the team based on the skill assessment and new project requirement.


**Basic Qualifications(requirements)**
* Degree in Mechanical engineering
* MBA Operations (Preferable)
* Min 15 year experience in Machine shop and Assembly Shop
* Well convergent with SAP/Microsoft Office tools


**Desired Qualifications**
* Demonstrated integrity – accept and adhere to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, and actions when dealing with others
* Lean Mindset and understanding of lean tool. (VSM, 5S, Inventory Management)
* Resolves internal issues quickly to meet customer expectations
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Data Analysis
* Ability to coordinate activities of different teams / projects


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Quality Manager
description:
**Quality Manager – MOBA India** 




**Company:** 

 MOBA Mobile Automation India Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Location:** 

 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 




**Experience:** 

 7\-10 years
 




**Industry:** 

 Off\-Highway Electronics / OEM Supply / Industrial Manufacturing
 




  





**About MOBA India** 





 MOBA India is part of MOBA Mobile Automation AG, Germany, a globally respected brand in the off\-highway electronics and automation industry with nearly 50 years of innovation. The company serves leading OEMs across road construction, mining, agriculture, and aerial work platforms, and in India has grown from a small team in 2004 to a 170\+ member organization serving globally recognized customers such as L\&T, Ammann, Volvo, JCB, CNH, and Atlas Copco.
 




  





**Role Purpose** 





 MOBA India is looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead the quality function from the ground up. This role is not limited to end\-of\-line inspection; it requires establishing a structured Quality Management System, introducing Total Quality Management practices, building quality processes and documentation, leading internal audits, and embedding quality across incoming, in\-process, final inspection, supplier quality, customer quality, and continuous improvement activities in line with standard manufacturing expectations.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**·** 

 Build, implement, and continuously improve the company Quality Management System covering process definition, documentation, control, compliance, and governance.
 




**·** 

 Develop quality foundation documents including SOPs, inspection standards, process maps, quality control plans, check sheets, work instructions, nonconformity handling formats, CAPA systems, deviation control, and controlled records.
 




**·** 

 Move the organization beyond end\-of\-line inspection by introducing incoming quality control, in\-process quality checks, stage\-wise inspection criteria, process audits, and structured quality feedback loops with production and engineering.
 




**·** 

 Deploy practical quality tools such as Control Plan, PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, 8D, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action systems as relevant to OEM\-facing manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Lead internal audits, support customer audits, prepare the organization for external certification or compliance reviews, and drive closure of audit findings across functions.
 




**·** 

 Establish quality KPIs such as rejection ppm, first pass yield, rework, supplier defects, field failures, customer complaints, warranty trends, and CAPA closure effectiveness, with regular reporting to management.
 




**·** 

 Work closely with Production, Stores, SCM, Engineering, Service, and Management to ensure quality is built into processes rather than checked only at dispatch.
 




**·** 

 Develop supplier quality practices including supplier qualification support, incoming inspection standards, supplier corrective action, and supplier performance monitoring.
 




**·** 

 Ensure calibration planning, measurement system discipline, traceability, and controlled use of gauges, fixtures, and testing equipment.
 




**·** 

 Build organization\-wide quality awareness through training, documentation discipline, audit readiness, and practical implementation of standard quality practices on the shop floor.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 




**·** 

 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
 




**·** 

 7–10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, preferably in industrial electronics, automotive components, off\-highway equipment, or OEM\-facing manufacturing environments.
 




**·** 

 Proven experience in setting up or significantly strengthening a quality system from scratch, not only managing final inspection activities.
 




**·** 

 Strong hands\-on knowledge of ISO 9001 and practical implementation of process\-based QMS in manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, Control Plan, FMEA, SPC, MSA, CAPA, NCR, 8D, and internal audit systems.
 




**·** 

 Experience in handling customer quality expectations, audit preparation, and closure of nonconformities through cross\-functional coordination.
 




**·** 

 Strong leadership, communication, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




**·** 

 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor qualification in ISO 9001 preferred.
 




**·** 

 Exposure to IATF 16949\-style core tools or similar OEM quality expectations is highly desirable.
 




**·** 

 Experience in electronics assembly, rugged industrial products, or low\-to\-medium volume OEM supply environments is an added advantage.
